BabyBlues.1:
I-baby blues nempilo yemizwa
ngemva kokubeletha
BabyBlues.2: Ukuqonda ukuthi yini engashintsha emizweni ngemva kokubeletha nokwazi ukuthi ucela kanjani usizo.
BabyBlues.8: Ngemva kokubeletha, kuvamile ukuba nesikhathi lapho imizwa yenza uzizwe uthintheka kakhulu. I-baby blues imvamisa iba isikhashana, kodwa ukucindezeleka okuqhubekayo noma okukhulayo kudinga ukunakwa ngochwepheshe.
BabyBlues.14: I-baby blues noma ukucindezeleka ngemva kokubeletha?
BabyBlues.19: I-baby blues isikhathi sezinguquko zemizwa okungenzeka sibe khona emalangeni ambalwa okuqala ngemva kokubeletha. Ukushintsha kwama-hormone, ukukhathala, ukuntuleka kokulala, nokujwayela leli leveli elisha kungaba nesandla kulokhu kuthinteka.
BabyBlues.20: Lokhu akuyona ukwehluleka futhi akusho ukuthi ungumama ongalungile. Wonke umuntu uhlangabezana nezinsuku zokuqala ngemva kokubeletha ngendlela yakhe.
BabyBlues.22: I-baby blues ivamile ngemva kokubeletha futhi imvamisa iyaphila yodwa emalangeni ambalwa.
BabyBlues.25: Okuhlangenwe nakho kuyahlukahluka. Abanye bazwa kakhulu ukukhathala nokuthinteka, kanti abanye bangaba nezinguquko zemizwa ezibonakala kakhulu.
BabyBlues.27: Ukukhala kalula noma ukuzwa uthintheka ngokukhethekile.
BabyBlues.29: Imizwa ingazwakala inamandla kakhulu futhi ishintshe ngokushesha.
BabyBlues.31: Ukuzizwa uthambile kungashintshana nezikhathi zokuzizwa kahle.
BabyBlues.36: Kulesi sikhathi, isidingo sokuphumula siyikhulu. Izinto ezincane nezilula zingenza izinsuku zibe lula kakhulu.
BabyBlues.38: Sebenzisa noma yisiphi isikhathi esikhululekile ukuze uphinde ube namandla.
BabyBlues.45: “Ukucela usizo ngemva kokubeletha kuyindlela yokuzinakekela wena nengane yakho.”
BabyBlues.47: I-baby blues noma ukucindezeleka ngemva kokubeletha?
BabyBlues.48: I-baby blues imvamisa iba isikhashana futhi iyalunga kancane kancane. Ukucindezeleka ngemva kokubeletha kuhlukile: kungaqhubeka isikhathi eside, kube namandla kakhulu, futhi kube nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yansuku zonke.
BabyBlues.51: Imvamisa iba isikhashana, ilunga kancane kancane emalangeni alandelayo.
BabyBlues.53: Kungaqhubeka isikhathi eside, kukhule, futhi kudinge ukwesekwa ngochwepheshe.
BabyBlues.56: Kubalulekile ukukhuluma nochwepheshe wezempilo uma ukucindezeleka kwemizwa kungalungi, kuba namandla kakhulu, noma kuqala ukwenza impilo yansuku zonke ibe nzima.
BabyBlues.60: Usizi noma ukukhathazeka kuba namandla kakhulu.
BabyBlues.61: Kuba nzima ukuzinakekela wena noma ingane yakho.
BabyBlues.64: Umbelethisi, udokotela, usokhaya wengqondo, noma omunye uchwepheshe wezempilo angakulalela, ahlole isimo, futhi akunike ukwesekwa okufanele.
BabyBlues.66: Imizwa yangemva kokubeletha akusona isilinganiso sokuthi ungumama omuhle kangakanani. Unelungelo lokudinga ukuphumula, lokulalelwa, nelokwesekwa.
BabyBlues.70: Ukukhathala nezinguquko zama-hormone kungathinta isimo sengqondo.
BabyBlues.71: Ukwesekwa yilabo abakuzungezile kungenza lesi sikhathi sibe lula.
BabyBlues.72: Ukucindezeleka okuqhubekayo noma okukhulu kudinga ukuhlolwa ngochwepheshe.
BabyBlues.73: Lesi sihloko siwukwazisa kuphela futhi asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esikuphathelene wena. Uma unokungabaza noma unokucindezeleka okukhulu, khuluma nochwepheshe wezempilo.
BabyBlues.74: Ukuzinakekela wena nakho kuyingxenye yesikhathi sangemva kokubeletha.

Isikhokelo sokuqonda izinguquko zemizwa ezivamile ngemva kokubeletha.

BabyDevelopment.6: Ukuthi ingane yakho ikhula kanjani, ngokwezikhathi ezintathu zokukhulelwa.
BabyDevelopment.14: Kusukela ngeviki lesi-6, inhliziyo encane seyiqala ukushaya. Phakathi nalesi sikhathi sokuqala, izitho eziyinhloko ziyakheka kancane kancane.
BabyDevelopment.16: Ukushaya kwenhliziyo yengane kungenye yezimpawu zokuqala ezibonakalayo ku-ultrasound, imvamisa okuyisikhathi esiqatshelwayo ekunakekelweni kwakho.
BabyDevelopment.17: Cishe ngeviki lama-20, ngokuvamile ungazwa ukunyakaza kokuqala kwengane. Yilapho nezinzwa ziqala ukukhula.
BabyDevelopment.18: Kusukela esikhathini sesithathu, ingane inyuka isisindo ngokushesha futhi kancane kancane iya endaweni yokuzalwa.
BabyDevelopment.19: Isivinini sokukhula siyahlukahluka phakathi kwezingane: lezi zigaba zihlala ziyizilinganiso ezijwayelekile.
BabyDevelopment.20: Kusukela emaviki ayi-6: inhliziyo iqala ukushaya
BabyDevelopment.21: Cishe emaviki angama-20: kuzwakala ukunyakaza kokuqala
BabyDevelopment.23: Cishe emaviki angama-28: amehlo avuleka kancane kancane
BabyDevelopment.24: Ingane “izwa konke” kusukela ekuqaleni: ukuzwa akukhuli ngempela kuze kube sesikhathini sesibili
BabyDevelopment.25: Isimo sesisu sikhomba ubulili bengane: asikho ubufakazi besayensi obusekela lokhu
BabyDevelopment.26: Ingane enomdlalo kakhulu inempilo engcono ngempela: izinga lomdlalo lihluka kakhulu phakathi kwezingane
BabyDevelopment.28: Isigaba ngasinye sokukhula kwengane silandela isivinini saso; ukuhlolwa njalo ngodokotela kusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle.

BasalTemperature.6: Indlela elula yokuqinisekisa, ngemva kwesikhathi, ukuthi ukukhipha iqanda sekwenzekile.
BasalTemperature.15: Ubushisa bomzimba bokuphumula bushisa bomzimba wakho uphumule ngokuphelele, ngaphambi kwanoma yimuphi umsebenzi. Buyahlukahluka kancane kakhulu phakathi nomjikelezo, ngaphansi kwethonya lama-hormone akho.
BasalTemperature.16: Bulinganiswa ekuseni ngalinye, ngaphambi kokuthi uvuke, njalo ngesikhathi esifanayo nangethemomitha efanayo.
BasalTemperature.18: Njalo sebenzisa ithemomitha efanayo, kungaba kuhle uma kuyithemomitha yobushisa bokuphumula (ichaza kangcono, kuze kube yingxenye yeshumi yedigri).
BasalTemperature.20: Linganisa ngesikhathi esimisiwe, ngaphambi kokuvuka, ngemva kwamahora okungenani angu-3 okulala ungaphazanyiswa.
BasalTemperature.22: Bhala umphumela ngokushesha, ngaphambi kokuvuka noma ukukhuluma.
BasalTemperature.23: Ubushisa bomzimba bokuphumula buyakhuphuka kancane (0.2 kuya ku-0.5°C) ngemva nje kokukhipha iqanda, ngenxa ye-progesterone, futhi buhlala bukhulu kuze kufike isikhathi sakho esilandelayo.
BasalTemperature.25: Iba phansi engxenyeni yokuqala yomjikelezo, ikhuphuka ngemva kokukhipha iqanda futhi ihlale lapho — iphethini ecaca kuphela ngemva kwezinsuku eziningi zokulinganisa.
BasalTemperature.30: Ukudinwa uhambo lwamabanga amade kamuva nje
BasalTemperature.31: Lena akuyona indlela yokubikezela kodwa yokuqinisekisa: isiza ukuqonda kangcono umjikelezo wakho, ngemva kokuba ukukhipha iqanda sekwenzekile — hhayi ukukulindela.
BasalTemperature.32: Ukubuka wedwa phakathi komjikelezo oyedwa noma emibili imvamisa akwanele: iphethini iyavela ngokuphindaphindeka.
BasalTemperature.34: Akukho ukukhuphuka kobushisa phakathi kwemijikelezo eminingana ephelele
BasalTemperature.35: Ubushisa buhlala buguquguquka kakhulu naphezu kokulinganisa ngokucophelela
BasalTemperature.36: Unemibuzo ngokuzala kwakho engeke iphendulwe ukulandelela kwedwa
BasalTemperature.38: Ukuhlanganisa ubushisa bomzimba bokuphumula nokubuka i-cervical mucus yakho noma izivivinyo zokukhipha iqanda kunikeza isithombe esiphelele somjikelezo wakho.
BasalTemperature.39: Ubushisa bomzimba bokuphumula buyakhuphuka kancane (0.2 kuya ku-0.5°C) ngemva nje kokukhipha iqanda, ngenxa ye-progesterone.
BasalTemperature.40: Bulinganiswa ekuseni ngalinye, ngaphambi kokuvuka, njalo ngesikhathi esifanayo nangethemomitha efanayo.
BasalTemperature.41: Lena akuyona indlela yokubikezela kodwa yokuqinisekisa: isiza ukuqonda kangcono umjikelezo wakho.
BasalTemperature.42: Ukuyihlanganisa nezinye izimpawu (i-cervical mucus, izivivinyo zokukhipha iqanda) kunikeza isithombe esiphelele.
BasalTemperature.43: Okokwazisa. Lesi sihloko asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esikuphathelene wena. Uma unokungabaza, cela isiqondiso kuchwepheshe wezempilo.

BirthControlPills.6: Ukuthi iphilisi lisebenza kanjani, ukulisebenzisa nsuku zonke, nezinzuzo nemikhawulo yalo eyinhloko.
BirthControlPills.12: Iphilisi liqukethe ama-hormone — i-estrogen kanye/noma i-progestin, kuye ngohlobo — asebenza ikakhulukazi ngokuvimbela noma ukuvala ukukhipha iqanda. Liphinde lishintshe i-cervical mucus, okwenza kube nzima ukuba isidoda sidlule.
BirthControlPills.14: Kunezinhlobo eziningana zamaphilisi, kuhlanganise amaphilisi ahlanganisiwe namaphilisi e-progestin kuphela. Okuqukethwe kwawo nendlela asetshenziswa ngayo kungahluka.
BirthControlPills.15: Ukulisebenzisa njalo kubalulekile. Kuye ngohlobo lwephilisi, okufaneleukwenziwe ngemva kokweqa umthamo kungahluka — ngakho kubalulekile ukufunda incwadi ekuhlangene nomuthi wakho.
BirthControlPills.16: Khetha isikhathi sosuku esilula ukusikhumbula (ukudla, ukulala...)
BirthControlPills.17: Sebenzisa isikhumbuzo noma uhlelo lokusebenza uma kudingeka
BirthControlPills.18: Gcina incwadi ekuhlangene nomuthi isondele uma kukhona ukungabaza
BirthControlPills.19: Njenganoma iyiphi indlela yokuvikela ukukhulelwa, iphilisi linezinzuzo kodwa futhi linemikhawulo ethile okufanele yaziwe ngaphambi kokulikhetha.
BirthControlPills.22: Lehlisa kakhulu ingozi yokukhulelwa uma lisetshenziswa kahle
BirthControlPills.23: Lingenza isikhathi sibe njalo futhi sibikezeleke
BirthControlPills.28: Lidinga ukusetshenziswa njalo kuye ngohlobo lwephilisi
BirthControlPills.33: Iphilisi iyindlela esebenza kahle yokuvikela ukukhulelwa ngama-hormone uma isetshenziswa kahle. Ukulisebenzisa njalo, imiphumela yalo engaba khona engemihle, nokungavikeli ezifweni ze-STI kuyizinto ezibalulekile okufanele zaziwe.
BirthControlPills.34: Uma ucabanga ngokuvikela ukukhulelwa noma indlela yakho yamanje ingakufanele, ungabazi ukukhuluma nodokotela, umbelethisi, noma omunye uchwepheshe wezempilo.

BoneHealth.6: Ukuthi kungani i-menopause ikhulisa ingozi ye-osteoporosis, nokuthi ungawavikela kanjani amathambo akho nsuku zonke.
BoneHealth.14: I-estrogen ngokwemvelo isiza ukuvikela ukujiya kwamathambo ngokunciphisa ukushintshwa kwamathambo. Ukwehla kwe-estrogen phakathi ne-menopause kusheshisa ukulahlekelwa kwamathambo, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni embalwa yokuqala ngemva kokuba isikhathi sakho sinyamalala.
BoneHealth.15: I-osteopenia ichaza ukujiya kwamathambo okungaphansi kokujwayelekile, kungafinyeleli esilinganisweni se-osteoporosis. I-osteoporosis ukubuthaka kwamathambo okukhulu kakhulu okukhulisa ingozi yokuphuka, ikakhulukazi uma kuwa.
BoneHealth.17: Amagama womabili achaza ukulahlekelwa ukujiya kwamathambo, hhayi ukuphuka sekwenzekile — angukukhuthaza ukuvikela, hhayi isizathu sokukhathazeka.
BoneHealth.18: Lokhu kuhlolwa okungabuhlungu kulinganisa ukujiya kwamaminerali amathambo. Kungase kunikezwe kuye ngeminyaka yakho, umlando wakho nowomndeni, noma ezinye izinto eziyingozi ezikhonjiswe nodokotela wakho.
BoneHealth.26: Umzimba omncane kakhulu noma ukungasebenzi kakhulu ngokomzimba
BoneHealth.28: Ukuba nesinye noma ezimbalwa zalezi zinto akusho ukuthi uzoba ne-osteoporosis — zikhona ikakhulukazi ukusiza ukuqondisa ingxoxo nodokotela wakho mayelana nokuhlolwa okungenzeka.
BoneHealth.30: I-calcium, i-vitamin D, nokuzivocavoca okuthwala isisindo kuhlala kuyizindlela ezisebenza kakhulu zansuku zonke zokulondoloza amandla amathambo isikhathi eside.

Breastfeeding.7: Izinsuku zokuqala zokuncelisa ibele isikhathi sokufunda kwengane nomama. Ukubamba ibele, isigqi, indlela yokubamba, nokubuka kusiza kancane kancane ukuthola okukhululekile.
Breastfeeding.16: Ukuncelisa ibele kuqala kancane kancane. Amahora okuqala, bese izinsuku zokuqala, zinika ingane nomama isikhathi sokufunda ndawonye.
Breastfeeding.20: Ukuthinta isikhumba ngesikhumba nokubamba ibele kusenesikhathi kungasiza ukuncelisa ibele kuqale kahle.
Breastfeeding.22: Ingane ingancela kaningi. Kujwayelekile ukuba isigqi sihluke.
Breastfeeding.24: Ukuncela kuba kancane kancane isigqi esabelwana yingane nomama.
Breastfeeding.26: Ubisi luzilungisa kancane kancane ezidingweni zengane.
Breastfeeding.28: Esikhundleni sokugxila kuphela esikhathini, kungasiza ukubuka izimpawu zokuvuka kwengane, ukuncela, nenani lamanabukeni.
Breastfeeding.30: Ingane esanda kuzalwa ingacela ukuncela kaningi, kwesinye isikhathi izikhathi eziyi-8 kuya kwezingu-12 emahoreni angama-24.
Breastfeeding.32: Ingane ingahamba, ivule umlomo, noma ifune ibele uma iqala ukulambela.
Breastfeeding.34: Inani lamanabukeni manzi nawonakele lingolunye lwezinto okufanele zibhekwe nsuku zonke.
Breastfeeding.36: Isimo esikhululekile nokubamba okuphumelelayo kungenza ukuncela kube lula. Uma ubuhlungu bukhulu noma buqhubeka, uchwepheshe wezempilo angahlola isimo nokubamba.
Breastfeeding.42: Ingane ibanjwa eduze nomzimba, nekhanda lisendaweni ekhululekile.
Breastfeeding.44: Linda ukuvuleka komlomo okwanele ngaphambi kokunikeza ibele.
Breastfeeding.46: Ukubamba okuphumelelayo akufanele kubangele ubuhlungu obukhulu noma obuqhubekayo.
Breastfeeding.48: Ukunyakaza kokuncela nokuginya kungabonakala phakathi nokuncela.
Breastfeeding.50: Akudingeki ukuthi ulinde kuze kube nzima kakhulu. Uchwepheshe oqeqeshiwe angasiza ukuhlola isimo, ukubamba, noma izidingo zengane.
Breastfeeding.58: Izinsuku zokuqala zingahluka kakhulu. Isigqi sokuncela nenani lobisi kungashintsha kancane kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Uma kukhona okukukhathazayo, cela iseluleko kuchwepheshe wezempilo.
Breastfeeding.60: Ukuncela kokuqala kuyisikhathi sokufunda kwengane nomama.
Breastfeeding.61: Ingane esanda kuzalwa ingacela ukuncela kaningi.
Breastfeeding.63: Ukubuka izimpawu zengane kwenza kahle kakhulu kunokuphishekela ishejuli emisiwe ngokuphelele.
Breastfeeding.64: Umbelethisi noma umeluleki wokuncelisa ibele angakusiza ngezinkinga zokuqala.
Breastfeeding.65: Okokwazisa. Lesi sihloko asithathi indawo yesiqondiso esikuphathelene wena sikachwepheshe wezempilo.

CervicalMucus.6: Uphawu lwemvelo, olungenakhokhelo, lokubona isikhathi sakho sokuzala.
CervicalMucus.15: Uketshezi lwemvelo olukhiqizwa ngumlomo wesibeletho. I-cervical mucus ishintsha ukuthungwa kwayo phakathi nomjikelezo ngaphansi kwethonya le-estrogen ne-progesterone.
CervicalMucus.21: Icacile, iyandiza, futhi iyalulama, ifana nomhlophe weqanda eliluhlaza.
CervicalMucus.30: Buka ukubukeka nokuthungwa usebenzisa iphepha lasendlini encane noma iminwe ehlanzekile, cishe ngesikhathi esifanayo sosuku, bese ubhala lokho okubonayo.
CervicalMucus.33: Ukuvikela ukukhulelwa ngama-hormone noma ezinye izindlela zokwelapha
CervicalMucus.35: Wonke umuntu unephrofayili ehlukile, futhi ukuqaphela eyakho kudinga ukuzijwayeza emijikelezweni eminingana. Ukubuka lolu shintsho nsuku zonke, kanye nezinye izimpawu, kusiza ukukhomba kangcono isikhathi sakho sokuzala — kodwa akuthathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha uma ukhathazekile.
CervicalMucus.37: Ukuhlanganisa i-cervical mucus nobushisa bomzimba wakho bokuphumula noma izivivinyo zokukhipha iqanda kunikeza isithombe esiphelele somjikelezo wakho.
CervicalMucus.38: I-cervical mucus ishintsha ukuthungwa kwayo phakathi nomjikelezo ngaphansi kwethonya le-estrogen ne-progesterone.
CervicalMucus.39: Lapho ukukhipha iqanda sekusondele, iba icacile, iyandiza, futhi iyalulama, ifana nomhlophe weqanda eliluhlaza.
CervicalMucus.40: Ukubuka lolu shintsho nsuku zonke, kanye nezinye izimpawu, kusiza ukukhomba kangcono isikhathi sakho sokuzala.
CervicalMucus.41: Ukuqaphela iphethini yakho kudinga ukuzijwayeza kanye nemijikelezo eminingana yokubuka.
CervicalMucus.42: Okokwazisa. Lesi sihloko asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esikuphathelene wena. Uma unokungabaza, cela isiqondiso kuchwepheshe wezempilo.

ChildbirthPrep.6: Izinsika ezintathu zokusondela osukwini olukhulu ngokuzethemba okwengeziwe.
ChildbirthPrep.16: Amakilasi okulungiselela ukubeletha akusiza uqonde izigaba zokubeletha namasu okuphefumula azokwesekela osukwini olukhulu.
ChildbirthPrep.17: Ukulungiselela isikhwama sakho sasesibhedlela ngenyanga yesi-8 kukonga ukucindezeleka kwesikhashana sokugcina. Imvamisa siqukethe:
ChildbirthPrep.18: Imibhalo yokuhlonza nencwadi yakho yokulandelela ukukhulelwa
ChildbirthPrep.25: Uhlelo lokubeletha olulula lusiza ukwabelana ngezifiso zakho neqembu lezokwelapha, kuyilapho uhlala unengqondo evulekile: indlela izinto ezenzeka ngayo ngempela ingashintsha kuye ngesimo.
ChildbirthPrep.27: Ukulungiselela akusho ukulawula yonke into: kuwukuzinika izindlela zokusondela osukwini olukhulu ngokuzethemba okwengeziwe nokungabaza okuncane.

ChooseHormonalMethod.6: Imibuzo efanele ukuzibuza yona ukuze uthole indlela yokuvikela ukukhulelwa ehambisana nempilo yakho yansuku zonke, izidingo zakho, nezinhloso zakho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.13: Ayikho indlela eyodwa efanelekile yokuvikela ukukhulelwa kuwo wonke umuntu. Ngaphambi kokukhetha indlela, kungasiza ukucabanga ngemikhuba yakho, izifiso zakho, ukukwazi ukuyiphatha, nezinhloso zakho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.15: Ngidinga isenzo sansuku zonke noma seviki, noma isixazululo esihlala isikhathi eside?
ChooseHormonalMethod.17: Siyini isabelomali sami, futhi yitholakala kanjani le ndlela yokuvikela ukukhulelwa?
ChooseHormonalMethod.18: Abantu ababili bangakhetha izindlela ezahlukene bese bobabili benze isinqumo esifanele kakhulu esimeni sabo. Ukukhetha okufanele kuncike ikakhulukazi ekutheni ufuna ukuyisebenzisa kanjani indlela yakho nokuthi ufuna ini.
ChooseHormonalMethod.20: Indlela ebukeka ikhangayo ephepheni ayisoze yaba yona engaba lula noma ekhululekile kakhulu kuwe nsuku zonke.
ChooseHormonalMethod.21: Ukuze uqhathanise izinketho eziningana, ungabheka imibandela ehlukene. Inhloso akuyona ukwazi konke ngekhanda, kodwa ukukhomba lokho okubalulekile ngempela kuwe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.23: Ezinye izindlela zidinga isenzo sansuku zonke, kanti ezinye zidinga ukunakwa seviki kuphela, noma kancane kakhulu.
ChooseHormonalMethod.25: Imiphumela oyizwayo ingahluka phakathi kwabantu. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi umzimba wakho uphendula kanjani nokukhuluma uma kukhona okukuphazamisayo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.27: Uma ufisa ukukhulelwa maduze, isikhathi sokusebenzisa nokubuya kokuzala ngemva kokuyeka kungaba yingxenye yalokho enikuxoxa.
ChooseHormonalMethod.29: Ukusebenza akuncikile kuphela endleleni ekhethiwe, kodwa nasekuyisebenziseni kahle futhi njalo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.31: Umehluko owodwa obalulekile phakathi kwezindlela ukuthi udinga ukucabanga ngokuvikela kwakho ukukhulelwa kaningi kangakanani.
ChooseHormonalMethod.42: Ukubuka ukuthi umzimba wakho uphendula kanjani
ChooseHormonalMethod.43: Indlela yama-hormone ingazwakala ihlukile kumuntu nomuntu. Abanye baqaphela izinguquko emjikelezweni wabo, ekopheni, noma eminye imiphumela engemihle. Lezi zimpendulo azisho ngokuzenzakalela ukuthi indlela ayikufanele, kodwa kufanele zinakwe.
ChooseHormonalMethod.45: Uma umphumela ukhulu, uqhubeka, noma ungajwayelekile, ungahlali wedwa nemibuzo yakho. Udokotela, umbelethisi, noma omunye uchwepheshe wezempilo angakusiza unqume ukuthi uqhubeke, ulungise, noma ushintshe indlela.
ChooseHormonalMethod.47: Amaplani akho okukhulelwa nawo angathinta ukukhetha kwakho. Uma ufuna ukugwema ukukhulelwa iminyaka eminingana, indlela ehlala isikhathi eside ingafaneleka ukucatshangelwa. Uma ucabanga ngokukhulelwa msinyane, ezinye izinketho zingase zihambisane kangcono nesikhathi sakho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.49: Ukukhuluma ngamaplani akho okukhulelwa, noma asese kude noma engaqinisekile, kusiza uchwepheshe wezempilo ukuqondisa ingxoxo kangcono.
ChooseHormonalMethod.50: Isikhathi sokuhlangana sikuvumela ukulinganisa izinzuzo, izithiyo, nokungavumelani okungenzeka kwendlela ngayinye. Ungalungiselela imibuzo embalwa ngaphambili ukuze ungakhohlwa lutho olubalulekile.
ChooseHormonalMethod.55: Kufanele ngenzenjani uma ngikhohlwa, uma ishintsha indawo, noma uma ngifuna ukuyiyeka?
ChooseHormonalMethod.56: Ingabe le ndlela ihambisana namaplani ami okukhulelwa?
ChooseHormonalMethod.58: Umbelethisi noma udokotela angabheka umlando wakho wezokwelapha, izindlela zokwelapha, izifiso, nendlela yokuphila ngaphambi kokukhuthaza indlela.
ChooseHormonalMethod.60: Khetha indlela ehambisana nempilo yakho yansuku zonke.
ChooseHormonalMethod.61: Cabangela ukukwazi kwakho ukuyiphatha nezifiso zakho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.62: Cabanga ngamaplani akho okukhulelwa nesikhathi sakho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.65: Indlela engcono akuyona ngempela leyo ebonakala ilula kakhulu noma ethandwa kakhulu. Yileyo ehambisana nesimo sakho, izidingo zakho, nezifiso zakho, ngemva kwengxoxo enolwazi nochwepheshe wezempilo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.66: Lesi sihloko siwukwazisa kuphela futhi asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esikuphathelene wena.

ConceptionLifestyle.6: Imikhuba elula engasekela uhambo lwakho — ngaphandle kokucindezela.
ConceptionLifestyle.12: Eminye imikhuba elula yokuphila ingasekela uhambo lokukhulelwa, nakuba ingeke iqinisekise umphumela yodwa.
ConceptionLifestyle.17: Ukucindezeleka okuhlala isikhathi eside kungathinta ukulingana kwama-hormone futhi, kwabanye besifazane, ukuhleleka komjikelezo. Ukuzinika izikhathi zokuthula kuyingxenye ephelele yohambo.
ConceptionLifestyle.19: Ukufisa “ukwenza konke kahle” kungaba yisona ngokwaso umthombo wokucindezeleka: ukuphishekela imikhuba enempilo ngokujwayelekile kwanele, ngaphandle kokufuna ukuphelela.
ConceptionLifestyle.20: Ukubhema, okungathinta ukuzala kwabo bobabili abalingani
ConceptionLifestyle.22: Ukuqeqeshwa kwezemidlalo okunamandla futhi okuhlala isikhathi eside, okungase kunciphise ukuzala
ConceptionLifestyle.23: Ushukela ocwengisisiwe ongaphezulu, ongase aphazamise ukulingana kwama-hormone
ConceptionLifestyle.25: Imikhuba elinganiselayo ngokujwayelekile, ngaphandle kokweqisa noma ukufuna ukuphelela, iyisekelo esingcono sansuku zonke.

ConceptionStart.6: Izinkomba ezibalulekile zokuqala uhambo lwakho lokukhulelwa ngokuzethemba.
ConceptionStart.12: Isinyathelo sokuqala esiwusizo kakhulu ukukhomba isikhathi sakho sokuzala usebenzisa umjikelezo wakho: ubude bomjikelezo, izimpawu zomzimba, futhi, uma uthanda, amathuluzi okulandelela afana nezivivinyo zokukhipha iqanda noma ubushisa bomzimba bokuphumula.
ConceptionStart.13: Ukuba nocansi njalo, njalo ezinsukwini ezi-2 kuya kwezi-3, kuhlanganisa ngokwemvelo isikhathi sakho sokuzala kakhulu ngaphandle kokudinga ukuhlela okuqinile ngokweqile.
ConceptionStart.14: Akudingeki uzibophe osukwini lokukhipha iqanda kuphela
ConceptionStart.15: Isigqi esijwayelekile silula ukusigcina kunokuhlela okuqinile
ConceptionStart.16: Intokozo yabashadile nayo ibalulekile ngalesi sikhathi
ConceptionStart.17: Iningi lamaphela likhulelwa phakathi nezinyanga eziyi-12 ngemva kokuyeka ukuvikela ukukhulelwa. Lesi sikhathi siyahlukahluka kuye ngezinto eziningi ezihlobene nesimo ngasinye.
ConceptionStart.19: Ngaphezu kwezinyanga eziyi-12 (noma izinyanga eziyi-6 ngemva kweminyaka engama-35), kunconywa ukubona uchwepheshe wezempilo ukuze kuhlolwe, nakuba lokhu kungasho ukuthi kunenkinga.
ConceptionStart.21: Ukwazi umjikelezo wakho, ukugcina isigqi semvelo, nokuba nesineke izinsika ezintathu zokuqala kahle lolu hambo.
